messages:
melissa_sales: FYI customer (IotaHealth) uploaded a CAIQ PDF during POC signup and flagged a few items they need answered before the demo tomorrow AM. Can security triage & assign? cc @arun_security @tom_se

arun_security: On it. Can you paste contact + which CAIQ questions they circled so we can scope? Also: is PII/PHI in scope for the POC data?

melissa_sales: Contact: julia.perez@iotahealth.io / +44 7700 900123. They circled: key management (BYOK), data residency (EU only), SCIM/SSO details, and logging/retention. They said sample PHI will be used in the POC environment.

tom_se: POC will run on Dedicated trial in eu-west-1 (ireland). We can stand up a dedicated cluster with a temporary KMS key for BYOK testing. Audit logs are available and can be forwarded to their syslog collector.

arun_security: Assigning to @sasha_security for intake. I'll create a security intake record and link to Jira. Note PHI in POC -> escalate compliance if they ask for BAA.

sasha_security: Got it. Quick clarifying q's: 1) Do they need persistent BYOK during trial or just to demonstrate key rotation/rotation policy? 2) Any contractual ask (DPA/BAA) today or post-trial? 3) Do they want proof of data residency (diagram + control statement) or an attestation?

melissa_sales: They asked to "test BYOK end-to-end" during demo (rotate key, verify access revoked). No BAA yet but likely after trial. They asked for a simple attestation that data will not leave EU and that storage will be in eu-west-1.

lina_support: Created SECINT-2025-214 and linked Jira SECURITY-2142. Owner: sasha_security. Priority: P1 (POC). Added tom_se and melissa_sales as watchers.

intakebot: AUTOMATION: SECINT-2025-214 created. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SECINT-2025-214. SLA: 48h initial response.

sasha_security: Initial operational answers we can share (non-contractual): - Data residency: Dedicated clusters provisioned in eu-west-1; control plane limited to our EU region for Dedicated customers when requested. - In-transit: TLS 1.2+ enforced for control and data plane. - At-rest: AES-256 default; KMS-based customer-managed keys supported on Dedicated. - Audit logs: configurable retention and syslog/forwarding available. I'll draft a short customer-facing FAQ and include an example KMS config snippet.

sasha_security: Example snippet for BYOK (non-prod): `kmsKey: "projects/PROJ/locations/eu/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck1"` and note: temporary keys are supported for trials but we require production keys to meet rotation/sep-of-duties controls.

tom_se: I can provide the POC cluster details and enable a temporary KMS key for the demo. Ping me when you're ready and I'll share access (rbac + logs).

sasha_security: Thanks. I'll prepare two artifacts: 1) Operational answers (email to customer) 2) Security summary for legal/compliance (if they request a BAA/DPA). ETA initial draft in 18 hours.

lina_support: Adding note on the Jira: "Customer to supply network diagram and expected sample dataset schema". Also tagging compliance for awareness.

melissa_sales: Great, please expedite the draft as demo is in ~20 hours. I'll tell the customer security is drafting answers and request their network diagram now. :pray:

arun_security: If the customer insists on production-like BYOK behaviors for the POC (rotation + HSM-backed keys), escalate to compliance and get legal in the loop.

sasha_security: Will do. If they upload the CAIQ with highlighted sections, send it to me directly and I'll annotate. Planning to post the customer-facing reply to the thread once ready.

melissa_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll nudge the customer to upload diagrams and confirm demo scope.

intakebot: UPDATE: SECINT-2025-214 status set to "In Triage". Assignee: sasha_security. Due: 2025-04-03.
